# s178 — Print lean JSON without indentation

`--json --lean` exists to save an agent's tokens, but `_emit` still writes it with `indent=2`. Under `--lean`, write compact JSON (`separators=(",", ":")`, no indent), one document per line. Full `--json` stays pretty.

**Findings:** efficiency review 2026-10-04: --lean output is pretty-printed; compact separators cut list 28%, status 40%, find 26%, log 22% · **Size:** S · **Tree:** cli

**Not in this slice:** changing full `--json` output; changing error envelopes, which stay pretty under `--lean` as they do today; changing which keys `lean()` drops; the on-disk format in `jsonio`; a separate `--compact` flag.

## Why

`_emit` (`src/slicer/cli.py:67-73`) always calls `json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)`. Measured on this repo on 2026-10-04 by re-serialising each `--json --lean` output compactly:

| command | lean bytes | compact bytes | saved |
|---|---|---|---|
| `list --json --lean` | 3,416 | 2,480 | 28% |
| `status --json --lean` | 1,307 | 797 | 40% |
| `find worktree --json --lean` | 9,792 | 7,313 | 26% |
| `log --json --lean` | 3,295 | 2,597 | 22% |
| `next --ready --section Implement --section Check --json --lean` | 1,828 | 1,703 | 7% |
| `show s184 --json --lean` | 6,163 | 5,798 | 6% |

A model reads compact JSON as well as indented. S92 built `--lean` and did not consider whitespace. Every consumer parses the output with a JSON parser, and `json.loads` accepts both forms.

## Failing tests

Add these to `tests/test_lean.py`:

1. `test_LeanOutput_IsOneCompactLine`: in a `support.TempRepo` with two items, `list --json --lean` stdout is one line plus its trailing newline. It contains no `": "` and no `", "` outside string values; check by asserting `out == json.dumps(json.loads(out), ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"`.
2. `test_FullJson_StaysIndented`: `list --json` stdout still equals `json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n"`.
3. `test_LeanErrorEnvelope_StaysIndented`: `show S99 --json --lean` exits 2, and stdout is the indented envelope, unchanged.
4. `test_LeanCompact_KeepsNonAscii`: an item titled `Café` comes back as `Café` in lean output, not as `é`.

Existing tests that parse lean output with `json.loads` must keep passing unchanged. If any test compares lean output to an indented string, change it to compare parsed objects. Find them with `rg -n '"--lean"' tests`.

## Implement

In `_emit`, when `lean` is set, call `json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))`. Otherwise keep `indent=2`. Leave `_error_envelope` (`:2188-2198`) alone. Change the `--lean` help to `with --json, compact output that omits empty fields, a repeated short title, and an item path`. In docs/agents.md, add one sentence to the lean paragraph: `Lean output is compact, one line with no indentation; full --json stays indented.` CHANGELOG: Unreleased → Changed. Say that lean JSON is now compact and that parsers are unaffected.

## Check

The failing tests pass, then `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests`, `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m slicer check`, and `git diff --check`. Re-measure `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m slicer list --json --lean | wc -c` against the Why table.
